Name: False Harros
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
**False Harros**

Among the most dangerous of the false Eidolons, the false Eidolon that serves as Harros’ shadow is so completely self-assured in their identity that they don’t suffer from the insanity other false Eidolons risk. There is no doubt in their mind that they are the embodiment of the sun, and this single-minded determination is supported by their unparalleled power and influence. They don’t put any thought into the fact that they are warmongers, who seek to conquer and control. They end up acting like bandit lords more than gods, accumulating power, influence, wealth and influence “as befits the sun”.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: The false Eidolon’s spellcasting ability is Charisma. They can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

traits.name: Mantle of the False Sun (Mythic Awakening)
traits.description: When the false Eidolon would be reduced to 0 hit points or killed outright, it undergoes a dramatic transformation into a huge, fiendish creature. Its hit points reset to 300, it regains its spent uses of its Legendary Resistance, and its body morphs into a Colossal psuedo-bestial fiendish monstrosity for 1 hour. If the space it’s in can’t fit it, its body is destroyed and it appears in a space that can fit it within 1000 feet. During this hour all attacks against it have advantage, it becomes resistant to all damage, and it can use its Mythic Actions. A party that defeats this false Eidolon after using its Mantle of the False Sun is awarded an additional 90,000 XP (180,000 XP total).

traits.name: Siphon the Devout
traits.description: When the false Eidolon would be reduced to 0 hit points while worshippers who believe in their dogma exist within 1000 feet of them, they can siphon the souls of any number of those willing worshippers, killing them to reduce the damage they would take by an amount equal to the remaining hit points of the killed individuals.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description:
The false Eidolon chooses one of two options when attacking:
• It makes four weapon attacks, choosing between its Solopsist Halberd and Necroflash Javelin.
• It makes one Bite Attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Solopsist Halberd
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d8 + 9) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Necroflash Javelin
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +12 to hit, range 90/270 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) radiant damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Mythic Action: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 8) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Mythic Action: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Mythic Action: Reverse Spiral Vortex (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The body of the false Eidolon is covered in a swirling spiral aura that expands outward, culminating in a bright, destructive flash of energy. Each creature within 60 feet of the false Eidolon must make a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) force damage and 44 (8d10) radiant damage on a failed save. Each target that fails is also blinded until the end of the false Eidolon’s next turn.

entries.name: Strike
entries.description: The false Eidolon makes a Solopsist Halberd or Claw attack.

entries.name: Dark Rally (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: Up to three creatures the false Eidolon chooses within 60 feet of it have advantage on the next attack roll, saving throw or ability check they make before the end of their next turn. Furthermore, each of them can use their reaction to move up to 30 feet and make a single weapon attack.

entries.name: Force Vanquish (Costs 3 Actions)
entries.description: The false Eidolon creates a sphere of force and hurls it at a point it can see within 60 feet, where it expands into a 20-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that space must succeed a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or lose concentration on any effect they’re concentrating on, and are pushed back from the center of the sphere by a number of feet equal to 4d4 × 5 feet, where they fall prone.

mythic_actions.description: The creature may use the following actions as Legendary Actions for 1 hour after using their Mythic Awakening.

entries.name: Meteorfall (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: The false Eidolon summons six meteors of pure radiant energy, each of which crash down at a point the false Eidolon chooses within 120 feet. Each explodes in a 5-foot-radius sphere. Any creature caught in one or more of these explosions must succeed a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) radiant damage on a failure.

entries.name: Radiating Death Wave (Costs 3 Actions)
entries.description:
The false Eidolon conjures a glaive of twisting necrotic and radiant energy, then plunges it into a space they can see within 100 feet. The energy erupts from the ground, filling a 60-foot-radius sphere centered there. This area is difficult terrain for all creatures apart from the false Eidolon until the start of its next turn, and during that time, when another creature enters a space within the radius or ends their turn within it, they take 5 (1d8) radiant damage and 5 (1d8) necrotic damage.

When this effect ends, each creature within the radius (except the false Eidolon) must succeed a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 11 (2d10) radiant damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.
